name: Yuugiri Ruriko
source:
Yuugiri Ruriko is [url=/c500]Shuuji’s[/url] kouhai, and also one of his childhood friends. She is a gentle girl who loves making sweets and is kind to everyone. Ruriko’s body is weak ever since she was small, and she lives next door to the [url=/c499]Mikaze[/url] house. Ruriko’s home is a clinic, and her overprotective brother is a doctor.

[Edited from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2010/02/02/asukimi-yuugiri-ruriko/]Rin's character review[/url].]
